claims.text: Casa Baglioni Milan is in the Brera district of Milan.

findings.quote: Casa Baglioni Milan is situated in the artistic Brera district.

claims.text: The hotel's design is inspired by the art and design of 1960s Milan, mixing traditional Italian style with modern innovation.

findings.quote: Inspired by the art & design of 1960s Milan, the hotel mixes traditional Italian style and modern innovation

claims.text: Room decor includes lighting by Panzeri, wallpaper by Rubelli, fabrics by Dedar and fittings by Zucchetti.

findings.quote: The decor includes lighting by Panzeri, wallpaper by Rubelli, fabrics by Dedar & taps/fittings by Zucchetti

claims.text: The Deluxe Suite is a tribute to Italian craftsmanship and Gio Ponti's Milan.

findings.quote: A hymn to the excellence of Italian craftsmanship and Giò Ponti’s Milan

claims.text: The Deluxe Suite comes with Acqua di Parma bathroom amenities.

findings.note: listed under the Deluxe Suite amenities

claims.text: Rooms are done in chestnut wood with midcentury sofas and armchairs.

findings.quote: Rooms are all chestnut wood with curves to die for and artful shelving; midcentury sofas and armchairs

claims.text: The lobby's neon-strip chandelier nods to Lucio Fontana-designed light fittings at the Museo del Novecento.

findings.quote: greeted first by the neon-strip swirly chandelier, a nod to the Lucio Fontana-designed light fittings at Museo del Novecento

claims.text: Claudio Sadler's tasting menu includes Milanese dishes such as risotto Milanese, veal and local cheese.

findings.quote: even on the tasting menu, you get a hint of the city’s unsung food culture: risotto Milanese, veal, and local cheese.

claims.text: The fitness center is equipped with Technogym machines.

findings.quote: which is equipped with the latest technogym machines.

claims.text: The hotel offers a tour of the Brera district that includes the Pinacoteca di Brera.

findings.quote: an exclusive tour of the Brera District—its own neighborhood. Stroll charming streets, browse art galleries, and explore the Pinacoteca di Brera

claims.text: Experiences offered include a private Lake Como trip from Milan.

findings.quote: Experience a refined, private Lake Como trip from Milan.

claims.text: Chef Claudio Sadler's cooking at the hotel reinvents regional Milanese traditions.

findings.quote: Chef Sadler blends the elegant dynamism of Milan, reinventing regional traditions with unmistakable style

claims.text: The hotel occupies a townhouse built in the 1910s that once belonged to fashion designer Philipp Plein.

findings.quote: This 1910s-built townhouse once belonged to fashion designer Philipp Plein

claims.text: The rooftop serves drinks and aperitivo with panoramic views of Milan.

findings.quote: Come up to the Rooftop for drinks, gourmet aperitivo & panoramic views of Milan.

claims.text: The suites feature inlaid wood floors and geometric shapes and colors typical of the Spatialist avant-garde movement.

findings.quote: Our stunning suites are characterized by inlaid wood floors, satin-finish fabrics & geometric shapes and colors typical of the Spatialist, avant-garde movement.

claims.text: The hotel's Wine Cellar can be booked for private tastings.

findings.quote: You can arrange for private tastings.

claims.text: Balconies with views of the Brera district come with some rooms, not all.

findings.quote: Some rooms offer balconies with views of the Brera district.

claims.text: Pets are welcome only if small or medium-sized, and a supplement is charged per stay.

findings.quote: We welcome small/medium-sized pets (max of 15 kilos/33 lbs.) A supplement of 50€ ($54 USD) per stay will be applied.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.
